scope: Baseline c1ac3eb source audit and unchanged local WAV sample analysis, followed by 0.2.29 bounded prepared-player implementation and verification. No subjective listening or physical-device output latency measured.

method.pcm: Signed little endian 16-bit integer, normalized by 32768; onset thresholds compare maximum absolute sample across channels. Window RMS combines channels, non-overlapping 10 ms windows.
method.limits: Sample threshold crossings are waveform evidence only, not human perceptual onset. RMS/peak is not loudness/masking proof. The source clips and production manifest were not changed.

findings.finding: Every short effect creates and prepares a fresh AVAudioPlayer in its scheduled main-queue callback, including zero-delay cues. No prepared-player reuse exists.
findings.implication: Avoidable construction and decoding preparation remains on the interaction-response path. Actual iPhone output latency is unmeasured.
findings.recommendedScope: Prewarm and reuse a bounded number of idle short-effect players without changing waveform, volume, scope, cadence, delay, concurrency or cancellation policies.
findings.resolution: In 0.2.29, startup prepares a bounded pool; ready short-effect cues lease without construction or prepare at the cue. Cache exhaustion/failure retains immediate-construction fallback. Verified by final 35 AudioPolicy cases within 466 App tests; physical audio latency remains unmeasured.

findings.finding: Combo source clips have unequal leading low-level or silent content: Nice/Great/Excellent first sample at or above -40 dBFS occurs at 60.159/118.730/102.789 ms. All local configured event delays are zero; temporary visual Combo delay is zero.
findings.implication: Zero scheduling delay does not guarantee same-frame perceived word onset. This alone does not establish a mismatch to Meowdoku.
findings.recommendedScope: Keep original waveforms intact. Record timings for later actual reference/device A/B instead of trimming source samples or inventing alignment offsets.

findings.finding: Temporary music gain remains 0.4 and effects/voice 0.9; background music, correct cue and Combo can overlap. Their PCM RMS/peak differ.
findings.implication: The audit has no subjective listening evidence that masking occurs; waveform RMS is not perceptual loudness.
findings.recommendedScope: Do not change gain or introduce ducking based on these measurements alone.

findings.finding: 0.2.27 local Combo shared voice channel replaces previous voice; normal swipe finishCurrent preserves active 182.381 ms mark samples and at most one already-due cue, discarding future queued cues.
findings.limitation: No new reference-game audio playback comparison or iPhone audio listening performed during this audit.

preparationProbe.host: macOS local command-line AVAudioPlayer; no play() or audio output
preparationProbe.scope: Sequential construction and prepareToPlay only, first per-file and 11 warm repetitions; not cold install, iPhone, simulator or action-to-audible latency.

modificationsAtDiagnosticStage: New report and ignored .build read-only audit scripts only; production code, tests, local audio configuration, WAV files and source reference manifest unchanged.

implementation.startup: The existing loading resource phase awaits optional audio preparation before Welcome. It never calls play(). Ambient category is set before real player preparation; no explicit session activation is requested by warmup.
implementation.ownership: Each prepared handle is exclusively leased to one playback. Shared mark/swipe files share cache capacity, not an active cursor. Cache overflow retains uncached fallback and original event/group concurrency handling.
implementation.lifecycle: Settings sound/voice changes, blocking background/ad/pause, interruption and media reset invalidate cache generations. Idle recycling prepares on a separate scheduled callback. Successful foreground/interrupt resume and reset request rewarming.

reviewFix.issue: The existing explicit music re-enable path clears a non-resumable interruption, but did not request short-effect cache rebuilding when sound/voice settings were unchanged. Playback correctly fell back to immediate construction, losing the optimization.
reviewFix.fix: Request cache rewarming only when an explicit music off-to-on change actually clears interrupted. shouldResume=false still prevents automatic playback/preparation.
reviewFix.test: Extended the existing lifecycle cache test with a fourth branch: non-resumable interruption remains silent and cacheless; explicit music re-enable triggers asynchronous new cache construction without calling manual preparation for that recovery.
reviewFix.validation: Passed in final 466-case App run, including all 35 AudioPolicy cases.

additionalReadOnlyReviewFix.issue: A failed deferred prepare left an idle, unready entry occupying cache capacity; a later warm call counted that entry but did not retry preparation. Audio still used a valid uncached fallback.
additionalReadOnlyReviewFix.fix: Each explicit warm request retries each idle unready handle once, cancels its older queued preparation, yields between entries, and preserves generation/background/interruption checks. It never retries until success or changes a leased cursor.
additionalReadOnlyReviewFix.test: Added a failure/recovery test proving a valid cue still plays through fallback, failed warm retries are bounded, successful warm does not stop the active fallback, and the repaired cached handle is subsequently reused at time zero.
additionalReadOnlyReviewFix.validation: Passed in final 466-case App run, including the failure/recovery scenario; AppModel startup comment corrected.
